title: Coventry agree deal for Forest striker Awoniyi
summary: Coventry City have agreed a £17 million deal to sign striker Taiwo Awoniyi from Nottingham Forest. The transfer strengthens Coventry's attacking options as they prepare for the season ahead.
content: Coventry City agree a deal worth about £17m for Nottingham Forest striker Taiwo Awoniyi.

title: Maguire wants 'huge threat' Rashford to stay at Man Utd
summary: Manchester United defender Harry Maguire has expressed hope that striker Marcus Rashford will remain at the club, describing him as a 'huge threat' to opposition. Maguire believes Rashford is vital to manager Michael Carrick's team.
content: Manchester United defender Harry Maguire says he hopes Marcus Rashford will stay at the club because he can improve Michael Carrick's team.

title: How important is Community Shield to a team's season?

content: Premier League champions Arsenal take on FA Cup winners Manchester City in Sunday's Community Shield - but would winning suggest a successful season ahead?

title: Strong favourites or tougher task - will Arsenal defend their title?

content: Arsenal begin this season as Premier League champions but just how difficult is it to defend the league title, and how well equipped as they for the challenge?
